claim_boundary: Candidate-by-uncertainty engineering stress test on Radeon. The 4,608 candidate-world pairs are not independent formal robot scenarios and do not establish physical-robot safety.

measurement_contract.minimum_clearance: minimum sampled AABB separation across declared robot links and non-target YCB clutter
measurement_contract.clutter_contact: strict positive AABB overlap at a five-step sample or phase endpoint
measurement_contract.stability: retained target lift divided by the requested 0.10 m lift, clamped to [0, 1]
measurement_contract.task_completed: reachable and stability at or above the frozen minimum
measurement_contract.elapsed_environment_steps: global batched control steps from approach start through lift settle, including the maximum declared start delay
